_comment: Fal AI image manifest for Local SEO Apex. Each entry generates one image via the fal CLI (fal-ai/flux/dev) using your existing `fal auth login` session — no API key required. Run: node scripts/generate-images.mjs  (add --force to regenerate; pass names to limit). A shared STYLE suffix is appended to every prompt in generate-images.mjs so the whole library reads as one art-directed system: editorial, natural light, premium, no text/logos/watermarks (Flux renders gibberish text, so we design it out). Density is 'balanced': photo heroes on major pages + purposeful image-bands, not imagery on every element.
style: editorial photograph, shot on 35mm, natural light, premium and authentic, muted sophisticated color grade with warm highlights, deep depth, high detail, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no signage, no captions
